title: Precomposition cylinder from a coherent natural equivalence
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor simplicial sets and coherent natural equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set and let $\eta:K\times\Delta^1\to K$ be a simplicial homotopy between maps $u,v:K\to K$. For every quasicategory $\mathcal C$, evaluation and composition define a simplicial map
$$H_\eta:\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)\times\Delta^1\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C),\qquad (F,t)\longmapsto F\circ\eta_t,$$
whose restrictions at the two endpoints are precomposition by $u$ and by $v$, respectively. The construction is natural under simplicial maps of the target $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Construction 1.5.3.1: internal functor simplicial sets and evaluation; the stated cylinder is their explicit composition consequence. Source read online 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED. Kerodon tag, not a Stacks tag.
